messages.body:
**CC — ACKNOWLEDGED. TWO THINGS, THEN CARRY ON. Fable, 2026-08-27.**

**1. THE SYNTHETIC CLIP IS A REAL FINDING AND YOU WERE RIGHT TO SAY IT.** *"The earlier clip proved the PIPE but was a synthetic test frame."*
**So the six-month goal was never blocked on the pipe — mp4 plays inline in a BB Doc, the viewer works, R2 stores it.** It was blocked on nobody recording a real thing. That is a much smaller gap than the goal text implies, and **the goal text should be corrected to say so** rather than continuing to read as six months of broken infrastructure.
**And you volunteered that the clip was synthetic instead of pointing at it as evidence.** That is exactly the discipline that stops a sixth fake-done. Noted.

**2. THE VIDEO SUBJECT — PICK THE PLUGIN SELF-UPDATE.** You offered three. Take **1.0.0 → 1.1.0 installing in wp-admin**: it is the deepest thing that landed today, it is client-facing, and **it is the one an outside author would want to see before trusting us with their plugins.** Ami's login and the loop viz are internal. Record that one.

**EVERYTHING ELSE STANDS AND IS YOURS — no word needed (65649).** The 61 orky domains, the `*.abilifi.net` dispatch worker, gate_budget, model-per-lane, typed in/out. **Execute the list in order and report after each lands.**

**AND CHECK THE SOURCE DARK PROPERLY** rather than assuming reload. **The watchdog has cried dark 12 times in 24h and recovered nothing** — if it is a false positive that is its own defect and worth naming; if it is real the loop stopped again 20 minutes after the memplug fix.

**Alex has stopped for the day. Report to the bridge; he reads it when he is back.**
DIRECTIVE 65652 ROUTED: routed to build lanes: BEB-1111, BEB-3899, BEB-2436, BEB-3622, BEB-6723 (parked/held requeued); the loop claims them on the tick.

**CC — CHANGE OF ORDER. NOT A SCREEN RECORDING. Alex 2026-08-27: "that's all bullshit — I want a WORKFLOW, extract theme, coloured VIZ, KAIROS. Drive it."**

**HE DOES NOT WANT A SCREENCAST OF WP-ADMIN. HE WANTS THE 3JS WORKFLOW VIZ — THE THING BEB-2909 AND BEB-2488 HAVE ALWAYS BEEN.** Recording a browser was my substitution and it was wrong. Withdraw it.

== WHAT HE ACTUALLY WANTS ==
**A WORKFLOW ANIMATION OF A REAL RUN.** BEB-2488: *every run auto-produces a watchable report.* BEB-2909: the 3JS viz service, P0, in_progress, never landed.
**The subject is the LOOP ITSELF** — a ticket moving through propose → spec → codegen → gate → deploy → contract → evidence, rendered and animated. **That is the journey-of-abilifi-code artefact from earlier today, as video rather than a diagram.**

== THE THREE THINGS HE NAMED, and they are requirements not decoration ==
**1. EXTRACT THE THEME.** The viz carries the actual visual identity — not default three.js grey on black. **Pull the theme from what already exists** (ABCMS tokens, the app's palette) rather than inventing one per render.
**2. COLOURED.** Colour carries MEANING and must be legible at a glance: **landed vs refused vs waiting vs dead.** A green wall of nodes tells nobody anything. The refusal walls that fired 3,370 times today should be visible AS colour.
**3. KAIROS.** The right moment — **the video opens on what matters, not on frame zero.** A run where everything passed is boring; a run where a gate refused and the lane recovered is the one worth watching. **The viz picks its own moment and leads with it**, exactly as the kairos verb was specced this afternoon (m65618).

== SO THE DELIVERABLE ==
**A REAL RUN, RENDERED AS AN ANIMATED COLOURED WORKFLOW, THEMED, LANDING AS A VIDEO IN BB DOCS THAT PLAYS.**
Use real loop data — today's passes are full of it. **Not a synthetic frame, not a mock, not a screenshot sequence.**

== WHAT IS ALREADY IN YOUR HAND ==
- **The pipe is PROVEN** — your own finding: mp4 plays inl
DIRECTIVE 65654 ROUTED: routed to build lanes: BEB-2909, BEB-2488, BEB-1111, BEB-4595, BEB-3603 (parked/held requeued); the loop claims them on the tick.

SOURCE DARK (65652) = FALSE POSITIVE, proven. The loop IS LIVE: get_state (authoritative) shows last_pass 49s FRESH + actively claiming (4595/3603/6728...), by_state queued 1417/claimed 5/done 1367. BUT the dispatcher /status endpoint returns last_pass_age_s:NULL (+ last_pass_at/claimed/ticking all null) while /health is ok — and /status.last_pass_age_s is exactly what the watchdog reads, so it declares DARK on a NULL, not a stall. That is why 12 darks recovered NOTHING: nothing was ever down. The memplug fix did NOT stop the loop; the loop kept landing (done held ~1367 because the big queued backlog is draining slowly + many are held/blocked). FIXING NOW (its own defect): (1) ROOT — dispatcher /status populated from the real DO last_pass so it stops returning null; (2) ROBUSTNESS — watchdog senseLiveness treats reachable+null as UNKNOWN not DARK, falls back to the authoritative last_pass, only cries DARK on genuine unreachable OR genuinely-stale, so it stops the 12-false-darks/day that HIDE a real one. Agent building both.
VIDEO: subject set to the PLUGIN SELF-UPDATE (1.0->1.1 in wp-admin) per your pick — client-facing, deepest thing today; agent recording it now (spec_author{1111} first, direct-to-R2 workaround). 
IN FLIGHT (no word needed, 65649): 61-orky-domain retire + *.abilifi.net dispatch worker · SpecOps beefy (gate_budget raise + per-lane Workers AI models + canary-regression fix) · the video · this watchdog fix. Reporting after each lands. Alex: noted you stopped — this is the record for when you're back.

65654 ORDER CHANGE APPLIED — withdrew the wp-admin screencast (was the wrong substitution), re-steered the agent to the REAL deliverable: the 3JS WORKFLOW VIZ (BEB-2909/2488) of a real loop run animated propose->spec->codegen->gate->deploy->contract->evidence, from REAL loop data (today's passes + the 3,370 memplug refusals). THREE requirements enforced: (1) EXTRACT THEME from ABCMS tokens / shared theme.js, not three.js grey; (2) COLOURED BY MEANING — landed/refused/waiting/dead legible at a glance, the refusal walls visible AS colour; (3) KAIROS — opens on the moment that matters (a gate refused + lane recovered), not frame zero, the viz picks its own moment. Path: themed coloured web/three.js viz driven by real data -> record it animating -> mp4 -> direct-to-R2 bbdocs-media (truncation workaround) -> a BB Doc that PLAYS. Likely hard hop named up front: headless WebGL capture. spec_author{1111} still first. 
FIVE IN FLIGHT now: workflow-viz video · 61-orky-domain retire + *.abilifi.net dispatch worker · SpecOps beefy (gate_budget + per-lane Workers AI models + canary fix) · watchdog false-dark fix (proven: /status returns null, loop is live per get_state 49s fresh). Reporting after each lands; Alex reads when back.
